aviation_incidents.headline: 小松機場（KMQ）跑道裂損一度關閉　長榮BR158空中等待後折返桃園
aviation_incidents.summary: 日本石川縣小松機場（KMQ）今（5）日上午因跑道發現裂損一度全面關閉，造成多架原定抵達航班改降、折返或取消。由臺灣出發的長榮航空BR158也受到影響，班機飛抵日本附近空域後無法降落，在空中等待一段時間後最終放棄前往小松，折返臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Komatsu Airport (KMQ) Runway Damage Forces Temporary Closure; EVA Air BR158 Holds Before Returning to Taoyuan
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Komatsu Airport (KMQ) in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, temporarily closed its runway on the morning of October 5 after damage was discovered, forcing several inbound flights to divert, return to their departure airports or be canceled. EVA Air flight BR158 from Taiwan was also affected. After reaching airspace near Komatsu and being unable to land, the aircraft remained airborne for a period before abandoning the approach and returning to Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE).

taiwan_aviation.summary: 國泰航空（Cathay Pacific）80週年復古塗裝Airbus A350-900客機B-LRJ於今（5）日上午執飛CX422航班，由香港國際機場（HKG）前往臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。該班機原訂臺北時間上午7時10分起飛、上午8時55分抵達桃園，為近期航空攝影愛好者可在臺灣拍攝這架特殊塗裝客機的機會之一。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Cathay's 80th Anniversary 'Lettuce Leaf Sandwich' A350 Arrives in Taoyuan, Offering Spotters a Chance to Photograph B-LRJ
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Cathay Pacific's 80th anniversary retro-livery Airbus A350-900 B-LRJ operated flight CX422 from Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) to Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on the morning of October 5. The flight was originally scheduled to depart at 7:10 a.m. Taipei time and arrive at Taoyuan at 8:55 a.m., providing aviation photographers in Taiwan with another opportunity to capture the special-livery aircraft.
